mapper.sql: SELECT l.link_id, l.activity_id, l.channel_id, l.channel_code, l.click_count, l.signup_count, l.lead_count, l.del_flag, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark, a.activity_name, c.account_name as channel_name, c.channel_type as channel_type_query FROM mk_activity_channel_link l LEFT JOIN mk_activity a ON l.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN mk_channel c ON l.channel_id = c.channel_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_activity_channel_link (activity_id, channel_id, channel_code, click_count, signup_count, lead_count, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{channelId}, #{channelCode}, IFNULL(#{clickCount}, 0), IFNULL(#{signupCount}, 0), IFNULL(#{leadCount}, 0), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mk_activity_channel_link WHERE link_id IN #{linkId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_activity_channel_link SET click_count = IFNULL(click_count, 0) + 1, update_time = sysdate() WHERE link_id = #{linkId}
UPDATE mk_activity_channel_link SET signup_count = IFNULL(signup_count, 0) + 1, update_time = sysdate() WHERE link_id = #{linkId}
UPDATE mk_activity_channel_link SET lead_count = IFNULL(lead_count, 0) + 1, update_time = sysdate() WHERE link_id = #{linkId}
